تزدجرن (form VIII)
# تَزْدَجِرْنَ (tazdajirna) /taz.da.d͡ʒir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# تُزْدَجَرْنَ (tuzdajarna) /tuz.da.d͡ʒar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
